engineMessages.LUNCH_WINDOW_OFF_GRID: The lunch window {windowStart}-{windowEnd} and its {minutes}-minute break do not fit the {slotMinutes}-minute scheduling grid. Use whole multiples of {slotMinutes} minutes.
engineMessages.LUNCH_WINDOW_SHORTER_THAN_BREAK: The lunch window {windowStart}-{windowEnd} is shorter than the {minutes}-minute lunch break it has to hold.
engineMessages.PROBE_NOTHING_HELPED: No timetable was found within {budget} s, and none of the {rules, plural, one {# rule} other {# rules}} probed made one appear inside {slice} s each. The week may simply be large; try a longer budget.
engineMessages.PROBE_NOTHING_HELPED_WITH_TRAVEL: No timetable was found within {budget} s, and none of the {rules, plural, one {# rule} other {# rules}} probed made one appear. The travel time was probed first, and the other rules only had the time it left. The week may simply be large; try a longer budget.
engineMessages.PROBE_ONE_RULE_HELPED: No timetable was found within {budget} s, but relaxing a single rule made the same week solve. {rules, plural, one {The rule is listed below} other {The # rules are listed below}} — a measurement, not a proof.
engineMessages.PROBE_SOLVED_WITHOUT_CHANGEOVER: With the margin between lessons set to 0, a timetable was found in {seconds} s.
engineMessages.PROBE_SOLVED_WITHOUT_PUPIL_BUFFERS: With the extra time the pupils need before and after their lessons set to 0, a timetable was found in {seconds} s.
engineMessages.PROBE_SOLVED_WITHOUT_DISTRIBUTION: With the subjects' distribution rules dropped — at most a number of lessons a day, no consecutive days — a timetable was found in {seconds} s.
engineMessages.PROBE_SOLVED_WITHOUT_BLOCKS: With the blocks dropped, so that the lessons of a block could take different times, a timetable was found in {seconds} s.
engineMessages.PROBE_SOLVED_WITHOUT_TEACHER_LUNCH: With the teachers' own guaranteed lunch switched off, a timetable was found in {seconds} s.
engineMessages.PROBE_SOLVED_WITHOUT_TEACHER_REST: With the teachers' own minimum rest between two teaching days switched off, a timetable was found in {seconds} s.
engineMessages.PROBE_SOLVED_WITHOUT_TEACHER_DAILY_CAP: With the teachers' cap on minutes of teaching a day switched off, a timetable was found in {seconds} s.
engineMessages.PROBE_SOLVED_WITHOUT_TEACHER_DAY_LIMITS: With the posts' limits on how many days a week a teacher teaches switched off, a timetable was found in {seconds} s.
engineMessages.PROBE_SOLVED_WITHOUT_DINING_SEATS: With the dining hall's seat limit removed, a timetable was found in {seconds} s.
engineMessages.PROBE_SOLVED_WITHOUT_LUNCH: With the guaranteed lunch break switched off, a timetable was found in {seconds} s.
engineMessages.PROBE_SOLVED_WITHOUT_LESSON_BEFORE_RAST: With the requirement of a lesson before a break dropped, a timetable was found in {seconds} s. The breaks themselves were left in place.
engineMessages.PROBE_SOLVED_WITHOUT_RASTS: With the rasts removed, a timetable was found in {seconds} s.
engineMessages.PROBE_SOLVED_WITHOUT_SERVINGS: With the lunch sittings per stage removed, so that the whole window was open to every stage, a timetable was found in {seconds} s.
engineMessages.RAST_NO_LESSON_FITS_BEFORE_IT: The classes named here require a lesson before a break, and their week leaves nowhere to put one: between the start of their day — or their previous break or lunch — and that break, no lesson of theirs fits. Move the break, shorten a lesson, or turn the requirement off for that break.
engineMessages.RAST_DEMANDS_A_LESSON_THAT_CANNOT_FIT: The break at {rast} on {day, select, 1 {Monday} 2 {Tuesday} 3 {Wednesday} 4 {Thursday} 5 {Friday} 6 {Saturday} 7 {Sunday} other {day {day}}} asks for a lesson before it, and none can fit: {grades, select, any {classes with unknown years} other {years {grades}}} have {remaining, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} between {opens} — {bound, select, lunch {the earliest their lunch can end} closed {what a reservation leaves of it} other {where the stretch opens}} — and that break, and the lesson of theirs that comes closest to fitting is {minutes} minutes. They can therefore never be at school after that break, and the days that are left hold {capacityMinutes} minutes against the {demandMinutes} their lessons need. Move the break, shorten the meal or widen its window, free the minutes a reservation holds, or turn the requirement off for that break.
engineMessages.RAST_DEMANDS_MORE_LESSONS_THAN_FIT_BEFOR: On {witnessDays, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} the first break that asks {grades, select, any {classes with unknown years} other {years {grades}}} for a lesson before it, with no locked lesson there already — on {day, select, 1 {Monday} 2 {Tuesday} 3 {Wednesday} 4 {Thursday} 5 {Friday} 6 {Saturday} 7 {Sunday} other {day {day}}}, the earliest of those days, the break at {rast} — can be answered by only {lessons, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}} of theirs a week, and a lesson is taught on one day. So on all but {lessons, plural, one {# of those days} other {# of those days}} they can never be at school after that break, and the week then holds at most {capacityMinutes} minutes against the {demandMinutes} their lessons need. Free a teacher or the minutes a reservation holds before the break, move the break, or turn the requirement off for that break.
engineMessages.RAST_NO_STRETCH_FOR_REQUIREMENT: The rasts leave no room for requirement {requirement} ({grades, select, any {years unknown} other {years {grades}}}): its {minutes}-minute lessons need an unbroken stretch, and the longest any day still offers is {remaining} minutes. {framed, select, 0 {Shorten a rast, or split the lesson.} other {Shorten a rast, widen the frame time, or split the lesson.}}
engineMessages.RAST_MARGIN_NO_STRETCH_FOR_REQUIREMENT: The rasts and the time around the lessons of requirement {requirement} ({grades, select, any {years unknown} other {years {grades}}}) together leave them no stretch to run in: its {minutes}-minute lessons take {before} minutes before and {after} minutes after for the pupils, {changeover, select, 0 {with no changeover between lessons} other {plus {changeover} minutes of changeover between lessons}}, none of which may run past the start or end of the day, and the longest stretch the rasts then leave any day for the lesson itself is {remaining} minutes. {framed, select, 0 {Shorten the lessons, or shorten those margins or a rast.} other {Shorten the lessons, shorten those margins or a rast, or widen the frame time.}}
engineMessages.LESSON_NO_START_FOR_REQUIREMENT: The {minutes}-minute lessons of requirement {requirement} ({grades, select, any {years unknown} other {years {grades}}}) have no start left on any day: the frame times, the rasts and the time around the lessons for the pupils leave them nowhere to begin. Shorten the lessons, or widen what they have to fit inside.
engineMessages.ROOM_LOCK_LEAVES_NO_ROOM: A room lock leaves requirement {requirement} ({grades, select, any {years unknown} other {years {grades}}}) nowhere to go: the rooms it names are too small, of the wrong type, or reserved for other years. Widen the lock, name another room, or change the room.
engineMessages.ROOM_LOCK_WEEK_TOO_SMALL: Room locks put {requirements, plural, one {# requirement} other {# requirements}} into {rooms, plural, one {# room} other {# rooms}} that cannot hold them: they need {neededMinutes} minutes a week and those rooms offer {offeredMinutes}. Name another room, or narrow which years the lock applies to.
engineMessages.ROOM_NONE_ELIGIBLE_FOR_REQUIREMENT: No room fits requirement {requirement} ({grades, select, any {years unknown} other {years {grades}}}): it needs room for {groupSize, plural, one {# student} other {# students}} and a room of type {roomType, select, any {any type} other {{roomType}}}.
engineMessages.ROOM_NO_ROOM_FOR_REQUIREMENT: Requirement {requirement} needs a room that holds {groupSize, plural, one {# student} other {# students}}.
engineMessages.ROOM_NO_ROOM_OF_TYPE_FOR_REQUIREMENT: Requirement {requirement} needs a room of type {roomType} that holds {groupSize, plural, one {# student} other {# students}}.
engineMessages.STAFF_TEACHER_NOT_QUALIFIED: {role, select, CO_TEACHER {The co-teacher} SUBSTITUTE {The substitute} other {The teacher}} has no qualification in {subject}{grades, select, any {} other { for years {grades}}}.
engineMessages.STAFF_TEACHER_OVER_TARGET: {role, select, CO_TEACHER {The co-teacher} SUBSTITUTE {The substitute} other {The teacher}} would carry {minutes} minutes a week against a target of {target} (the limit is {limit} with the {tolerance} % tolerance).
engineMessages.STAFF_TEACHER_OVER_TARGET_IN_PERIOD: {role, select, CO_TEACHER {The co-teacher} SUBSTITUTE {The substitute} other {The teacher}} would carry {minutes} minutes a week against a target of {target} from {from} to {to} (the limit is {limit} with the {tolerance} % tolerance).
engineMessages.STAFF_TEACHER_OVER_TARGET_HIDDEN: {role, select, CO_TEACHER {The co-teacher} SUBSTITUTE {The substitute} other {The teacher}} would carry more than the limit, the target with the {tolerance} % tolerance. The minutes are shown to the principal, a full administrator and anyone with HR read access.
engineMessages.GROUP_CONFLICTS_OVER_ENGINE_LIMIT: The groups that share pupils make {pairs} pairs, more than the {limit} the timetable engine takes in one run, so the week was not sent. Fewer groups that share pupils, or fewer replacing groups, bring the number down.
engineMessages.STAFF_UNSTAFFED_REQUIREMENTS: {count, plural, one {# curriculum entry has} other {# curriculum entries have}} no teacher, and the school's staffing policy refuses to generate a timetable until every entry has one. Staff the entries named here, or allow generation without a teacher in the staffing settings.
engineMessages.STAFF_NO_QUALIFIED_TEACHER_FOR_REQUIREME: {count, plural, one {# curriculum entry} other {# curriculum entries}} in {subject}{grades, select, any {} other { for years {grades}}} cannot be staffed: no active teacher holds a qualification that covers {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}. Record a qualification, or propose without respecting qualifications.
engineMessages.STAFF_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED_FOR_SUBJECT: {subject} needs {demandedMinutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} a week across {count, plural, one {# curriculum entry} other {# curriculum entries}}, and the teachers who may take them have at most {availableMinutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} left below their limits, so at least {shortMinutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} will stay unstaffed. Raise a target or the tolerance, record more qualifications, or reduce the subject's time.
engineMessages.STAFF_TEACHER_CAPACITY_ZERO: Already carries {fixedMinutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} a week against a limit of {limitMinutes}, so no further curriculum entry fits.
engineMessages.STAFF_MODEL_TOO_LARGE: There are too many possible teacher assignments to weigh in one go: about {variables} model variables against a limit of {limit}. Keep the entries that are settled as they are, or record qualifications so that fewer teachers are candidates for each entry, and try again.
engineMessages.SUBJECT_DISTRIBUTION_WEEK_TOO_SHORT: {requirement}: {lessons, plural, one {# lesson does} other {# lessons do}} not fit on the {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} it can be taught, with at most {maxPerDay} a day{minDaysBetween, select, 0 {} 2 { and none on consecutive days} other { and lesson days at least {minDaysBetween} days apart}}{locked, select, 0 {} other { ({locked} of them locked)}}. Allow more a day or closer days, or reduce the lessons per week.
engineMessages.SUBJECT_DISTRIBUTION_PER_DAY: {requirement} may have at most {maxPerDay, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}} a day, and that rule is one of those that cannot all hold at once. Allow more a day, or free a day it can be taught on.
engineMessages.SUBJECT_DISTRIBUTION_DAYS_APART: {requirement} may not have lessons {minDaysBetween, select, 2 {on consecutive days} other {on days less than {minDaysBetween} days apart}}, and that rule is one of those that cannot all hold at once. Allow closer days, or free days it can be taught on.
engineMessages.DISTRIBUTION_TOO_MANY_ON_DAY: {requirement} now has {count} lessons on {day, select, 1 {Monday} 2 {Tuesday} 3 {Wednesday} 4 {Thursday} 5 {Friday} 6 {Saturday} 7 {Sunday} other {day {day}}}, and its distribution rule allows at most {maxPerDay} a day.
engineMessages.DISTRIBUTION_DAYS_TOO_CLOSE: {requirement} now has lessons on {firstDay, select, 1 {Monday} 2 {Tuesday} 3 {Wednesday} 4 {Thursday} 5 {Friday} 6 {Saturday} 7 {Sunday} other {day {firstDay}}} and {secondDay, select, 1 {Monday} 2 {Tuesday} 3 {Wednesday} 4 {Thursday} 5 {Friday} 6 {Saturday} 7 {Sunday} other {day {secondDay}}}, and its distribution rule {minDaysBetween, select, 2 {allows no consecutive days} other {wants lesson days at least {minDaysBetween} days apart}}.
engineMessages.SHARE_LESSONS_DIFFER: {requirement} splits its lessons between teachers, and {role, select, PREVIOUS {the lesson's previous teacher} other {the lesson's teacher}} now has {lessons} of them in the timetable where the split gives {share}. Change the lesson's teacher, or the split in the entry's dialog.
engineMessages.BLOCK_MEMBERS_DIFFER: {block}: {requirement} does not have the same lessons as {other}, and the lessons of a block are placed at the same times. Give every entry in the block the same lessons per week and the same lengths.
engineMessages.BLOCK_MEMBERS_SHARE_TEACHER: {block}: {requirement} and {other} have the same teacher, who cannot teach both at the same time. Give one of them another teacher, or take it out of the block.
engineMessages.BLOCK_MEMBERS_SPLIT: {block}: {requirement} and {other} both have their lessons split between teachers, and the lessons of a block are placed together one by one. Give one of them one teacher again, or take it out of the block.
engineMessages.BLOCK_MEMBERS_SHARE_PUPILS: {block}: {requirement} and {other} share pupils, who cannot be in both at the same time. Take one of them out of the block, or let each pupil be in only one group of it.
engineMessages.BLOCK_NO_COMMON_START: {block}: its groups have no time in common at which a {minutes}-minute lesson can start, with the frame times, breaks and margins of their years. Widen the frame times, or take an entry out of the block.
engineMessages.BLOCK_CANNOT_BE_PLACED: {block} cannot have all its lessons at the same times, and that rule is one of those that cannot all hold at once. Check when its groups, teachers and rooms are free, or take an entry out of the block.
engineMessages.BLOCK_PROBE_SUMMARY: No timetable satisfies every rule, and the solver could not name which of them collide. With the blocks dropped a timetable was found in {seconds} s, so it is the blocks listed below that cannot all have their lessons at the same times.
engineMessages.BLOCK_PARTLY_LOCKED_SUMMARY: {count, plural, one {# block has} other {# blocks have}} lessons locked or placed by hand while the rest of the block is still to be placed, and a block's lessons are placed together.
engineMessages.BLOCK_PARTLY_LOCKED: {block} has {locked, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}} locked or placed by hand while the rest of it is still to be placed. Unlock the block's lessons and move any moved by hand back with the block, or lock all of them.
engineMessages.BLOCK_SAME_TIMES_PARTLY_LOCKED: {block} has {locked, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}} locked or placed by hand, while {other}, which takes the same times in other weeks, still has all of its lessons to place. Lock the two blocks together, or unlock {block}. Blocks of one entry each have no block card: select the lessons of both with shift-click and lock them together.
engineMessages.BLOCK_SAME_TIMES_DIFFER: {block} takes the times of {other}, and the two no longer fit together: they need the same subjects for the same groups (or, for a subject a class's halves take in turn, one entry on each half), with the same lessons, in weeks that never meet. Make them match again, where Change lessons on either block changes both, or delete {block} to place its lessons at times of their own.
engineMessages.BLOCK_SAME_TIMES_SPLIT_LESSONS: {block} takes the times of {other}, and {requirement} has its lessons split between teachers. A block on another block's times holds one teacher per entry for all its lessons, so give the entry one teacher again, or delete {block} to place its lessons at times of their own.
engineMessages.BLOCK_SAME_TIMES_TEACHERS: {block} takes the times of {other}, and has more teachers that {other} does not than the entries of {other} have room for beside their own. Give the entries of {block} the teachers of {other}, or take a co-teacher off {other}.
engineMessages.BLOCK_SPLIT: {block} is split: this lesson has left the rest of the block and now counts as placed by hand. Unless every lesson of the block is locked, the next generation refuses the block as partly locked. Move it back with the block, or lock all of the block's lessons.
engineMessages.TRAVEL_TIME_SHORT: {party, select, TEACHER {{name}} other {The pupils in {name}}} cannot make it from {from} to {to}: {gap} min between the lessons, and the walk takes {minutes} min ({other} {time}).
engineMessages.TEACHER_LUNCH_WINDOW_TOO_NARROW: The teacher working-time rule {rule} guarantees a {minutes}-minute lunch inside {windowStart}-{windowEnd}, and that window holds {remaining, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} of the school day. Widen the window, shorten the lunch, or move it inside the hours the school teaches in.
engineMessages.TEACHER_LUNCH_LEAVES_NO_START: {causes, select, locked {Locked lessons} closed {Reservations on the teacher} locked_closed {Locked lessons and reservations on the teacher} other {These rules}} leave the teacher working-time rule {rule} no {minutes}-minute lunch inside {windowStart}-{windowEnd} on {day, select, 1 {Monday} 2 {Tuesday} 3 {Wednesday} 4 {Thursday} 5 {Friday} 6 {Saturday} 7 {Sunday} other {day {day}}}. Move a locked lesson, shorten the reservation, or widen the window.
engineMessages.TEACHER_REST_LONGER_THAN_THE_NIGHT: The teacher working-time rule {rule} asks for {restMinutes} minutes between the last lesson of one day and the first of the next, and the longest night this week can give is {nightMinutes} minutes: the teacher's {lessons, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}} cannot all be placed on days that are not next to each other. Shorten the rest, lengthen the school day, or give this teacher fewer lessons.
engineMessages.TEACHER_LUNCH_HAS_NOWHERE_TO_GO: The {minutes}-minute lunch the teacher working-time rule {rule} guarantees inside {windowStart}-{windowEnd} on {day, select, 1 {Monday} 2 {Tuesday} 3 {Wednesday} 4 {Thursday} 5 {Friday} 6 {Saturday} 7 {Sunday} other {day {day}}} is one of the rules that cannot all hold at once: the teacher's lessons, the locked lessons and the reservations leave nowhere to put it. Widen the window, shorten the lunch, or free the middle of that day.
engineMessages.TEACHER_REST_CANNOT_BE_KEPT: The rest of {restMinutes} minutes that the teacher working-time rule {rule} asks for after {day, select, 1 {Monday} 2 {Tuesday} 3 {Wednesday} 4 {Thursday} 5 {Friday} 6 {Saturday} 7 {Sunday} other {day {day}}} is one of the rules that cannot all hold at once. Shorten the rest, or free the end of that day or the start of the next one.
engineMessages.TEACHER_DAILY_CAP_CANNOT_BE_KEPT: The cap of {minutes} minutes of teaching a day that the teacher working-time rule {rule} sets is one of the rules that cannot all hold at once on {day, select, 1 {Monday} 2 {Tuesday} 3 {Wednesday} 4 {Thursday} 5 {Friday} 6 {Saturday} 7 {Sunday} other {day {day}}}. Raise the cap, or free that day for the teacher's lessons.
engineMessages.TEACHER_DAILY_CAP_TOO_SMALL_FOR_WEEK: The teacher working-time rule {rule} allows at most {minutes} minutes of teaching a day, and the teacher has {weekMinutes} minutes of lessons still to place: more than the {days, plural, one {# school day} other {# school days}} of the week hold at that cap, once the lessons already locked are counted. Raise the cap, or give this teacher fewer lessons.
engineMessages.TEACHER_LESSON_LONGER_THAN_DAILY_CAP: The teacher working-time rule {rule} allows at most {minutes} minutes of teaching a day, and one of the teacher's lessons still to place is {lessonMinutes} minutes long on its own. Raise the cap, or shorten or split the lesson.
engineMessages.TEACHER_WORK_DAYS_CANNOT_BE_KEPT: The teacher's post {limit} allows teaching on at most {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} a week, and that limit is one of the rules that cannot all hold at once. Allow more days on the post, or give this teacher fewer lessons.
engineMessages.TEACHER_WORK_DAYS_TOO_FEW_FOR_WEEK: The teacher's post {limit} allows teaching on at most {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} a week, and the teacher has {weekMinutes} minutes of lessons still to place: more than that many days can hold, with the hours the school teaches in, the lessons already locked and any cap on the day. Allow more days on the post, or give this teacher fewer lessons.
engineMessages.TEACHER_WORK_DAYS_HIDDEN: A teacher's limit on how many days a week they teach is one of the reasons the timetable could not be made. The limit is shown to the principal, a full administrator and anyone with HR read access.
engineMessages.TEACHER_FREE_DAY_WISH_NOT_KEPT: A teacher wishes {day, select, 1 {Mondays} 2 {Tuesdays} 3 {Wednesdays} 4 {Thursdays} 5 {Fridays} 6 {Saturdays} 7 {Sundays} other {day {day}}} free, and the new timetable gives them lessons that day. A wish is weighed against the rest of the week and gives way where keeping it would cost more.
engineMessages.TEACHER_DAY_TOO_LONG: {role, select, CO_TEACHER {The co-teacher} other {The teacher}} of {requirement} now teaches {minutes} minutes on {day, select, 1 {Monday} 2 {Tuesday} 3 {Wednesday} 4 {Thursday} 5 {Friday} 6 {Saturday} 7 {Sunday} other {day {day}}}, more than the {cap} minutes a day their working-time rule allows.
engineMessages.TEACHER_WEEK_TOO_MANY_DAYS: {role, select, CO_TEACHER {The co-teacher} other {The teacher}} of {requirement} now teaches on {days} days a week, more than the {max} their post allows.
engineMessages.TEACHER_WEEK_TOO_MANY_DAYS_HIDDEN: {role, select, CO_TEACHER {The co-teacher} other {The teacher}} of {requirement} now teaches on more days a week than their post allows. The days are shown to the principal, a full administrator and anyone with HR read access.
engineMessages.PROBE_SOLVED_WITHOUT_TRAVEL: With the travel time between the school's sites dropped, a timetable was found in {seconds} s.
engineMessages.PROBE_TRAVEL_UNMEASURED: The travel time between the school's sites is turned on. Searching without it for {seconds} s did not find a timetable either, so whether it is the difference was not measured. A run with it turned off under School rules shows that.
engineMessages.TRAVEL_PROBE_SUMMARY: No timetable satisfies every rule, and the solver could not name which of them collide. With the travel time between the school's sites dropped a timetable was found in {seconds} s, so it is the travel time below that makes the week impossible.
engineMessages.PUPILS_TRAVEL_CANNOT_BE_KEPT: The school rules ask the generator to keep the travel time between the school's sites for pupils with lessons on two sites on one day, after their time to change, rounded up to whole start steps of {stepMinutes} min. {measured, select, 1 {That travel time is what makes the week impossible: without it, a timetable exists that keeps every other rule, and in it the pupils of the groups named here have less time than the travel time between two lessons on different sites.} 2 {That travel time makes the week impossible on its own: even with the other rules set aside, the lessons of the groups named here cannot be placed so that it fits. The week has other causes too: it stays impossible without the travel time.} other {That travel time is one of the rules that cannot all hold at once for the groups named here; whether it alone is the difference could not be measured.}} Let these groups' lessons use rooms on one site, shorten the travel time under Rooms, Sites, or turn it off under School rules.
engineMessages.TEACHER_TRAVEL_CANNOT_BE_KEPT: The school rules ask the generator to keep the travel time between the school's sites for every teacher with lessons on two sites on one day, rounded up to whole start steps of {stepMinutes} min. {measured, select, 1 {That travel time is what makes the week impossible: without it, a timetable exists that keeps every other rule, and in it the teachers named here have less time than the travel time between two lessons on different sites.} 2 {That travel time makes the week impossible on its own: even with the other rules set aside, the lessons of the teachers named here cannot be placed so that it fits. The week has other causes too: it stays impossible without the travel time.} other {That travel time is one of the rules that cannot all hold at once for the teachers named here; whether it alone is the difference could not be measured.}} Let these teachers' lessons use rooms on one site, shorten the travel time under Rooms, Sites, or turn it off under School rules.

timplanCoverage.pupilsBelow: {pupils, plural, one {# pupil} other {# pupils}} in the year's classes; {below, plural, =0 {none is below target} one {# is below target in at least one subject} other {# are below target in at least one subject}}.

timplanCohorts.sources: Sources, read 10 October 2026: SFS 2023:945 (annexes 1, 3 and 4) applies to stages not completed by 1 July 2024. SFS 2025:729 (issued 19 June 2025) introduces the ten-year compulsory school with 7,424 hours for cohorts starting grade 1 in autumn 2028; pupils already in school move up one extra grade and keep 6,890 hours in total (transitional provisions 4 and 12). Under SFS 2026:1243 (Govt. Bill 2025/26:194) timplans become part of the curricula, and the distribution by subject is expected in a curriculum ordinance after the Swedish National Agency for Education's proposals of 14 May 2027 (U2026/01483). The rollover into autumn 2028 moves every cohort up two grades and makes the year ten-year.

publishing.title: Publishing
publishing.intro: Decide how the base timetable reaches the calendar, see which published timetable is valid when, and choose what the Timetable viewer shows without a login.
publishing.modeDirectBody: Every change to the base timetable reaches the calendar when it is saved, and teachers, pupils and guardians see it at once. This is how Rastra timetable has always worked.
publishing.modeDraftBody: Changes to the base timetable are a draft only administrators see. Teachers, pupils, guardians and the app see the published timetable until someone publishes the draft.
publishing.modeToDraftConfirm: What is published now becomes the starting point. After that, a change to the base timetable reaches teachers, pupils and guardians only when someone publishes it.
publishing.modeToDirectConfirm: Only possible when no draft is waiting. After that, every change to the base timetable reaches the calendar directly again.
publishing.modeSwitchedDraft: The school now publishes through drafts.
publishing.validityBody: A published timetable is valid from one date up to and including another. A later publication takes over from its first date, and days before it are never rewritten.
publishing.validityNone: Nothing is published for the school year yet.
publishing.discardConfirm: The base timetable goes back to what is published. A version is saved first ("Före kasserat utkast"), so the draft can be restored from Versions.

publishing.refillBody: Writes the published timetable (not the draft) into the calendar again for the period, for example after a holiday was shortened or a closure removed. Days that have begun are left alone, and a lesson that already exists is not created twice.
publishing.refillWarnings: The refill has warnings. Read them and choose "Refill anyway" to go on:
publishing.refilled: {count, plural, one {# lesson was} other {# lessons were}} written into the calendar.
publishing.policyBody: The timetable is checked before every publication. Warns: the check is shown and publishing needs "Publish anyway". Stops: publishing is not possible until it is fixed. Every check warns until the school chooses otherwise.

discard.bodyActive: The proposals being computed are cancelled, and this school year's earlier proposals are deleted. The draft and the base timetable do not change.

lessonLog.title: Lesson
lessonLog.notFoundHint: It does not exist, or it belongs to another school.
lessonLog.loadFailed: The lesson could not be loaded
lessonLog.logDescription: The pupils on the lesson and their guardians see what you write here, beside the lesson in their timetable. Whether you write anything is up to you.
lessonLog.logReadOnly: What the lesson’s teacher has written. The pupils and their guardians see it beside the lesson.
lessonLog.topicHint: What the lesson is about, on one line. At most {max, number} characters.
lessonLog.homeworkHint: What should be done by next time. At most {max, number} characters.
lessonLog.logEmpty: No topic or homework has been written for this lesson.
lessonLog.notAMessage: Pupils and guardians cannot reply here, and nobody is notified of what you write. Questions and messages go through the school’s learning platform.
lessonLog.logStale: Someone else has changed the topic and homework since you opened the page
lessonLog.noteStale: Someone else has changed the note since you opened the page
lessonLog.staleHint: Load the latest version before you save, so that nothing is overwritten.
lessonLog.noteDescription: Only the lesson’s teachers and whoever covers it read the note. The school’s administrators see on the cover board that there is one. Pupils and guardians never see it.
lessonLog.noteForYou: The lesson’s teacher has left this note for you as the substitute.
lessonLog.noteHint: For example where the plan is and what the pupils should work on. At most {max, number} characters.
lessonLog.noteEmpty: No note has been left for this lesson.
lessonLog.weekDescription: What your teachers have written about this week’s lessons.
lessonLog.weekEmpty: Nothing has been written for this week’s lessons.
lessonLog.weekLoadFailed: Topic and homework could not be loaded

classBook.title: Class book
classBook.subtitleTeacher: A class’s lessons over a period, with topic and homework
classBook.subtitleAdmin: A class’s lessons over a period, with topic and homework. Whoever changes day-to-day operations can remove a text that should not stay.
classBook.periodBackwards: Choose a period whose end is not before its start.
classBook.periodTooLong: At most {max, number} days at a time.
classBook.noGroupHint: The class book shows the class’s lessons over the period, with what the teachers have written.
classBook.loadFailed: The class book could not be loaded
classBook.heading: Class book {group}
classBook.empty: The class has no lessons in the period.
classBook.footnote: The class book holds the class’s own lessons and those any of its pupils take part in, such as a language choice. Notes to substitutes never appear here.
classBook.attending: {group}, {count, plural, one {# of the class’s pupils} other {# of the class’s pupils}}
classBook.removeTitle: Remove the lesson’s topic and homework?
classBook.removeDescription: The text disappears for the pupils and guardians and from the class book. This cannot be undone.
classBook.removeFailed: It could not be removed. Try again.
classBook.removeStale: The teacher has changed the topic or homework since the class book was loaded. The class book now shows the new text, so you see what you remove.

huvudman.title: School owner
huvudman.subtitle: The schools the owner has, the owner's people and its SS12000 keys.
huvudman.notMember: This login is no member of any school owner.
huvudman.yourRole: You are {role} of the school owner.
huvudman.readsAsLasare: You read every school the owner has as that school's reader. You see everything the school's reader sees and change nothing at the school. Every read of personal data is written in the school's read log.
huvudman.schoolsIntro: A school becomes the owner's when its principal or a full administrator has accepted the request. The school and the owner may each end it.
huvudman.noSchools: The owner has no school yet.
huvudman.requestHint: Type the school's address in Rastra timetable, for example ekbackens-skola. The school's decision makers see the request under Data protection and answer it there.
huvudman.membersIntro: The municipal administrator invites and removes. Planners and municipal administrators read the schools, and neither writes anything at a school.
huvudman.keysIntro: A key reads every school the owner has, one school at a time, as the school's own integration key does. It reads no attendance or absence, and holds no subscription. The school sees the key and its reads.
huvudman.keyCreated: The key {name} is created. Copy it now: it is shown only once.
huvudman.keyFailed: The key could not be created.
huvudman.eventRELEASED: The owner let the school go
huvudman.doneReleased: The school is let go. The owner's people and keys read it no more.
huvudman.doneInvitedNoMail: The person is added. They already had a login, so no email went out.
huvudman.errorHUVUDMAN_NOT_YOURS: Only the owner's municipal administrator does that.
huvudman.errorHUVUDMAN_SCHOOL_IS_OURS: The school is the owner's already.
huvudman.errorHUVUDMAN_SCHOOL_HAS_A_HUVUDMAN: The school has an owner already.
huvudman.errorHUVUDMAN_SCHOOL_NOT_OURS: The school is not the owner's.
huvudman.errorHUVUDMAN_MEMBER_EXISTS: The owner already has someone with that address.
huvudman.errorHUVUDMAN_KEEPS_AN_ADMIN: The owner needs at least one active municipal administrator.
huvudman.errorHUVUDMAN_NOT_FOUND: The huvudman does not exist, or you are not one of its members.
huvudman.errorHUVUDMAN_MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: The person is not one of the huvudman's.
huvudman.errorHUVUDMAN_KEY_NOT_FOUND: The key does not exist, or is already revoked.
huvudman.errorHUVUDMAN_REFUSED: The huvudman does not allow that.
huvudman.errorOther: That did not work. Try again in a while.
huvudman.loadFailed: The owner could not be read just now. Try again in a while.
huvudman.confirmRelease: The owner's people and keys stop reading {school}. The school must accept a new request to undo it.
huvudman.confirmRevoke: The key {name} stops working now, and a revoked key cannot be brought back.
huvudman.confirmDeactivate: {name} stops reading the owner's schools now.
